setup: Give And Go Pattern With Flags Or Cones Standing In For A Defender. Cones are set 12 yards wide by 20 yards long. Two lines of players as shown. Players in line A each with a ball.
instructions: Player from line A dribbles straight at defender (flag or cone), then passes to feet to player B, says "one-two" and sprints forward.
Player B returns the pass with one touch into forward space then overlaps wide.
Player A receives the ball behind the defender and plays ball to overlapping B player.
Rotation: A goes to B, B goes to A.
coachingPoints: Dribble straight at defender to make him commit.
Player B: Face in so you can see the forward space and pass one touch.
